title: NCT STEMists Handbook: every award, 2021–2026
summary: The full record from the handbook of the STEM club I led at Nguyen Chi Thanh High School, with photos from each competition.
content: NCT STEMists was founded in 2017 at Nguyen Chi Thanh High School in Ho Chi Minh City and is guided by teachers Nguyen Minh Ly and Tran Thi Tu Anh. I led the club for three years, and its research team is where most of my projects began. This is the complete award record from the club handbook.
